release_notes: **ThetaPrime strategy-builder AI skill**: a downloadable skill that turns a plain-English strategy request into a Composer-importable `.spec.json` and validates it offline (`validate_spec.py`, stdlib-only, mirroring the app's own spec validation plus semantic checks — eod-before-entry error; naked-short-without-stop and never-enter-filter warnings). Served at `/composer/ai-skill.zip`, linked from the Build with AI dialog, and built on demand from the live block catalog so it can't drift from the shipped blocks. Documented in `docs/strategy-composer.md`. `docs/composer-strategy-examples.md`: seven recipes used a negative OTM % for the put leg, which the selector treats as in-the-money; all put legs now use a positive value. Also dropped the stale "delta-OTM not expressible" limitation — the 16-delta strangle is expressible via the Delta OTM selector.
